query: INSERT INTO sessions (session_id, account_id, token_hash, device_id, platform, label, created, last_seen, idle_expires, abs_expires, reauth_until) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET account_id = excluded.account_id, token_hash = excluded.token_hash, device_id = excluded.device_id, platform = excluded.platform, label = excluded.label, created = excluded.created, last_seen = excluded.last_seen, idle_expires = excluded.idle_expires, abs_expires = excluded.abs_expires, reauth_until = excluded.reauth_until
